description: Enroll in a template with Any Purpose (or SubCA) EKU and no approval, usable to authenticate as any principal.

telemetry.detail: Certificate Services received a certificate request (on the CA).
Certificate Services issued a certificate (on the CA).
PKINIT TGT request using the issued certificate - certificate-logon anomaly.
Any-Purpose/SubCA certificate issuance to a non-privileged requester is a template-misuse tell where CA logs are modelled.

prerequisite_privilege: Enrollment rights on an Any-Purpose/SubCA template with no manager approval
abuse_primitive: Enroll, then use the flexible-EKU cert for domain authentication.
notes: Same CA-side 4886/4887 signature as ESC1. The permissive EKU is the distinguishing artifact.
